ball.q: Legia Warsaw beat Celtic in a 2014 qualifier but were thrown out. What had they done wrong?
ball.sub: UEFA awarded Celtic a 3-0 win over the Poles.

ball.q: Celtic lost their 2011-12 play-off to Sion and still played in the group stage. Why?
ball.a: Sion were thrown out for fielding ineligible players
